the proposed BL-Luo converter-fed BLDC motor drive can be used as a suitable alternative to the conventional BLDC motor drive in the applications of power quality improvement.

the BL-Luo converter-fed BLDC motor drive can be a viable solution for applications requiring low-speed operation of the BLDC motors.
